entities.summary: Oliver Wakeman is an English musician and composer. He was a member of Yes from 2009 to 2011, filling the role of keyboardist previously held by his father, Rick Wakeman. He was the first member of the band to be born after the band's founding. Jon Davison would latter become the second.
